property_summary: Only the current owner can successfully call owned() or transferOwnership(newOwner); if a call by this contract (msg.sender) reverts, owner remains unchanged, otherwise owner becomes newOwner after a successful transferOwnership call.
If transferOwnership succeeds then the owner getter afterwards equals the newOwner; if it reverts then owner stays as it was before the call.

Calling transferOwnership from this test contract either reverts (and owner stays the same) or succeeds and sets owner to this contract (since msg.sender inside C will be this test contract after a successful call).
